name: Why choose a general contractor who handles both log refinishing and interior remodeling?

mainEntity.name: Why choose a general contractor who handles both log refinishing and interior remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Working with a full-scope remodeling and restoration contractor ensures that underlying moisture damage is corrected rather than simply covered up with fresh stain. If moisture has penetrated past the log siding or exterior joints, it can cause hidden rot in subfloors, structural framing, window headers, and interior drywall. A contractor who handles both exterior cabin refinishing and interior trades can address damaged sill logs, replace rotten framing, fix drywall, and coordinate any associated trade work without needing separate companies for each phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: A full-service contractor can fix exterior log seals as well as repair hidden moisture damage to interior framing, drywall, or trim.
